title: 第4章 御兽卡
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
林家的商铺就坐落在石铁城的中心地段，距离熔炉教堂不过两条街的距离。

    一路上，林奇都默默跟在林峰身后，低垂着头，紧紧攥着那张骨头卡。

    街道上的喧嚣仿佛与他隔绝，耳边还回荡着教堂里那些嘲讽的笑声，每一声都像针一样扎在心上。

    直到前方出现一块挂着“奇妙物语商店”的木质招牌，他这才停下脚步。

    “儿子，没有御卡师的天赋也没事。”

    林峰放缓脚步，拍了拍林奇的肩膀。

    “你小时候不还说，要成为熔炉王国第一首富吗？咱们把商铺开大，比那些只会靠卡牌耀武扬威的人强多了！”

    可他话还没说完，林奇就已经推开商铺的木门，头也不回地朝着二楼走去，只留下一个略显单薄的背影。

    “唉，这孩子……”

    林峰望着楼梯口，无奈地叹了口气。

    他太了解林奇了，这孩子看着大大咧咧，什么都不在乎，其实心里比谁都好强。

    从小到大，林奇做什么都要做到最好，如今在觉醒大典上受了这么大的委屈，心里肯定憋着一股劲。

    ......

    奇妙物语商店的二楼，是林奇的房间。

    房间不大，一张书桌、一张床，还有一个堆满了各种杂物的柜子，便是全部家当。

    林奇一进房间，就坐在书桌旁，将手中的骨头卡放在桌面上，眼神怔怔地盯着它。

    “一根骨头……”

    “怎么会是一根骨头呢……”

    “老天爷啊，不能因为我是去救狗，你就给我根骨头吧！你好歹给我张御兽卡，哪怕只是一张普通大黄狗的御兽卡也比骨头强啊……”

    林奇心态都有些崩了，心心念念的本命卡竟然是这么个玩意。

    “或许，这是根不一样的骨头呢？”

    林奇不死心，将自己稀少的源力注入在卡片上。

    没有任何光芒，也没有什么动静，一根小臂长短的骨头就这样静静地躺在桌子上。

    “这骨头……”

    林奇拿起骨头，翻来覆去地看了看，又挥舞了两下，语气里带着几分自嘲。

    “长度倒是还行，可惜厚度不够，要是根棒骨，说不定还能用来打人……”

    就算本命卡是一根骨头，林奇还是不死心自甘堕落。

    这里可是异世大陆，说不定这骨头也能变成厉害的武器呢。

    “可是，骨头的晋升路线是什么？”

    林奇想了想，又把脑海中另一张卡召唤出来。

    这张卡虽然通体是黑色，但却并没有任何光芒，在源卡大陆只要没有光芒的卡牌，都是废卡。

    卡牌正面刻着一个类似能量核心的图案，黑漆漆的，看不出任何特殊之处。

    之前他试过将这张卡牌内的东西拿出来，结果刚一召唤，体内的源力和精神力就被瞬间掏空，整个人直接昏睡了一天一夜，醒来后浑身酸痛，再也不敢轻易尝试。

    源力再次注入，手中骨头又变成了卡片。

    林奇左手核心卡，右手骨头卡。

    他左看看、右看看，最后双手一合，将两张卡拍在一起，大声喊道。

    “融合进化！！”

    房间内回荡着林奇的声音，结果两张卡还是什么事都没发生。

    “呵呵，呵呵……”

    林奇给自己气乐了，抓起本命卡就一阵撕扯。

    “骨头，烂骨头！”

    “还有你个破石头卡，都是废卡！”

    就在这时，楼下传来“噔噔噔”的脚步声，紧接着是林峰的声音。

    “儿子，看爹给你买了什么好东西。”

    林峰一把推开房门，声音里的兴奋戛然而止。

    他僵在原地，愣愣的看着手脚并用，甚至用嘴撕扯本命卡的林奇。

    “呃……”

    林奇的动作也瞬间僵住，他飞快地松开嘴，然后若无其事地坐直身体，一脸平静地看着林峰，仿佛刚才那个失态的人不是他。

    “说了多少次了，进我房间要敲门。万一我要是带个女生回来，你这突然闯进来，多不好。”

    林奇清了清嗓子，试图掩饰自己的尴尬。

    “哦，好。我下次注意。”

    林峰一脸讪笑的走了进来。

    “儿子，猜猜看，爹给你买了什么好东西？”

    林奇瞥了眼林峰藏在怀里的手。

    “藏在怀里，又没有鼓起来，说明东西很小，你买的什么卡？”

    林峰一脸懵逼，“这都猜得到？”

    他也不卖关子，从怀里掏出一张泛着绿光的卡牌，递到林奇面前。

    “当当当当！这可是绿色品质的御兽卡，风铃猫。”

    林奇低头一看，眼神里瞬间露出一丝惊讶。

    “二星御兽卡！？”

    这卡牌上画着一只模样可爱的白色小猫咪，正是卡兽风铃猫。
content_en:
The Lin family's shop is located in the center of Shitie City, only two blocks away from the Furnace Church.

Along the way, Lin Qi followed Lin Feng silently, with his head lowered and clutching the bone card tightly.

The hustle and bustle of the street seemed to be cut off from him, and the mocking laughter from the church still echoed in his ears, each sound pricking his heart like a needle.

He didn't stop until a wooden signboard with "Wonderful Story Store" appeared in front of him.

"Son, it's okay if you don't have the talent of a card master."

Lin Feng slowed down and patted Lin Qi on the shoulder.

"Didn't you say when you were a kid that you wanted to become the richest man in the Crucible Kingdom? If we open up a big store, we will be much better than those who only rely on cards to show off their power!"

But before he finished speaking, Lin Qi had already pushed open the wooden door of the shop and walked towards the second floor without looking back, leaving only a slightly thin figure behind.

"Alas, this child..."

Lin Feng looked at the stairs and sighed helplessly.

He knew Lin Qi very well. This kid looked careless and didn't care about anything, but in fact he was stronger than anyone else in his heart.

Growing up, Lin Qi always wanted to be the best in everything he did. Now that he had been so wronged at the Awakening Ceremony, he must be feeling a lot of energy in his heart.

...

On the second floor of the Wonderful Story store is Lynch's room.

The room is not big, with a desk, a bed, and a cabinet filled with various miscellaneous items, which is all the belongings.

As soon as Lynch entered the room, he sat at the desk, placed the bone card in his hand on the table, and stared at it blankly.

"A bone..."

"How could it be a bone..."

"God, you can't just give me a bone just because I'm going to rescue a dog! You can at least give me a beast control card. Even if it's just an ordinary big yellow dog's beast control card, it's better than a bone..."

Lin Qi's mentality was a bit broken. The natal card he had been thinking about turned out to be such a thing.

"Perhaps this is a different bone?"

Lynch refused to give up and poured his scarce energy into the card.

There was no light and no movement. A bone as long as a forearm lay quietly on the table.

"This bone..."

Lynch picked up the bone, looked at it over and over, and waved it twice, with a bit of self-deprecation in his tone.

"The length is okay, but it's a pity that it's not thick enough. If it were a stick, maybe it could be used to hit people..."

Even if the life card is a bone, Lynch still refuses to give up and is willing to fall.

This is a foreign land, maybe these bones can be turned into powerful weapons.

"But, what is Bone's promotion route?"

Lin Qi thought for a while and summoned another card in his mind.

Although this card is completely black, it does not have any light. In the Source Card Continent, any card without light is a useless card.

There is a pattern similar to an energy core engraved on the front of the card. It is dark and there is nothing special about it.

He had tried to take out the contents of this card before, but as soon as he summoned it, the source and spiritual power in his body were instantly drained. He fell into a coma for a day and a night. When he woke up, his whole body was sore, and he never dared to try it easily again.

Source power was injected again, and the bones in his hand turned into cards again.

Lynch has a core card in his left hand and a bone card in his right hand.

He looked left and right, and finally put his hands together, slapped the two cards together, and shouted loudly.

"Fusion Evolution!!"

Lynch's voice echoed in the room, but nothing happened to the two cards.

"Hehe, hehe..."

Lin Qi was so angry with himself that he grabbed the life card and tore it apart.

"Bones, rotten bones!"

"And you, you useless stone card, are all useless cards!"

At this moment, the sound of "thump thump thump" footsteps came downstairs, followed closely by Lin Feng's voice.

"Son, look what good things dad bought you."

Lin Feng pushed open the door, and the excitement in his voice suddenly stopped.

He froze in place, staring blankly at Lin Qi who was using his hands and feet, and even tearing the life card with his mouth.

"Uh..."

Lin Qi's movements froze for an instant. He quickly let go of his mouth, then sat up straight as if nothing had happened, looking at Lin Feng calmly, as if he was not the one who had lost his temper just now.

"How many times have I told you to knock on the door when entering my room? What if I bring a girl back and you suddenly barge in?"

Lynch cleared his throat, trying to hide his embarrassment.

"Oh, okay. I'll pay attention next time."

Lin Feng walked in with a sneer on his face.

"Son, guess what good stuff dad bought you?"

Lin Qi glanced at Lin Feng's hand hidden in his arms.

"It's hidden in your arms and it doesn't bulge, which means it's very small. What kind of card did you buy?"

Lin Feng looked confused, "Can you guess all this?"

He didn't show off, took out a green-glow card from his arms, and handed it to Lin Qi.

"Dang-dang-dang! This is a green-quality beast card, Wind Chime Cat."

Lin Qi looked down, with a hint of surprise in his eyes.

"Two-star beast control card!?"

There is a cute white kitten drawn on this card, which is Kamon Wind Chime Cat.
